abstract: Goldman Sachs analyzes the potential macroeconomic impact of generative AI, finding that approximately two-thirds of current jobs face some degree of exposure to AI automation. The report estimates that generative AI could substitute for up to one-fourth of current work globally, with significant implications for economic growth and labor market dynamics.
